notes: Times include harness serialization, process startup and shader compilation for Metal. Relative difference is max absolute error normalized by maximum absolute judge travel time. The Metal memory metric is a child high-water increase, not an individual process peak; warmup can make it zero. Judge tracemalloc may miss native allocations. Grid sizes and timings are estimates pending execution on the target machine.
